privacy.title: What this website collects
privacy.body: Page view counts through privacy-friendly analytics. No cookies are set for advertising, and no personal profile is built. The chamber can see that a page was viewed and roughly where from, not who viewed it.

privacy.title: What you give us on purpose
privacy.body: If you email the chamber, apply for membership, or register for an event, the chamber keeps what you sent so it can respond and keep records. Membership records include business contact details and payment history.

privacy.title: Signing in
privacy.body: Members and chamber admins who sign in get one cookie that keeps them signed in. It does nothing else and is not used for tracking or advertising. Signing out or closing the session ends it.

privacy.title: Listing stats
privacy.body: Member directory pages count how often they are viewed and how often someone taps to call, email, visit the website or get directions, so members can see what their listing does for them. Only the totals are kept. To avoid counting one person twice, a scrambled code made from your connection and the date is kept for one day and then deleted. No cookies are involved.

privacy.title: The newsletter
privacy.body: If you sign up, the chamber keeps your email address and the date you confirmed, and uses it only to send chamber news. Every newsletter has a one-click unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing deletes your address from the list.

privacy.title: Who else sees it
privacy.body: Your directory listing is public by design, because being found is the point. Nothing else is shared, sold, or rented. Event registration handled by a venue is subject to that venue’s own policy.

privacy.title: Services that run the site
privacy.body: A few outside companies handle parts of the work and only see what they need to do it: Stripe processes online payments, Resend delivers email, and Vercel hosts the site. Card numbers go straight to Stripe and never reach the chamber. Each company has its own privacy policy.

privacy.title: Keeping it safe
privacy.body: The whole site runs over an encrypted connection. Member and admin areas need a sign in, and only the board members and volunteers who need records for chamber work can see them.

privacy.title: How long it is kept
privacy.body: Membership and financial records are kept as long as the chamber is required to keep them for accounting and nonprofit reporting. Email is kept until it is no longer useful.

privacy.title: Changing or removing your information
privacy.body: Email the chamber at admin@polkcitychamber.com and it gets changed. A member who leaves can ask for their directory page to come down, and it will.

privacy.title: Links to other sites
privacy.body: This site links to a lot of other organizations, from state agencies to member websites. Once you leave, their privacy practices apply, not the chamber’s.

privacy.title: Children
privacy.body: This site is meant for adults and businesses. The chamber does not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

privacy.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.body: If this policy changes, the new version goes on this page with a new date at the top.
